summary: A coverage line's `surfaces` may include `typescript-api`, and a package contract lists only that surface (no `schema`). The message schema moved to version 1.1.0, so `_schema.version` on a coverage line is now "1.1.0".
why: The gate covers the public TypeScript API of published packages (flyingrobots/geordi#219). The gate classifies the changed `_schema.version` const as breaking; the enum value is additive.
